limitations: Utterance-disjoint only; speakers can overlap development/V1 and each other. Not speaker-independent or upstream training holdout proof. Read/broadcast speech, not shopping/TC2/microphone proof. Warmup intentionally reuses a development clip and is not scored. Post-response worker RSS is not sampled process peak. Timing is observational, not an SLA/speedup claim. Failed requests are empty hypotheses; no retries. No number-normalized intent metric.
